fire.title: Fire
fire.body: Active, outward, expansive energy. A natural drive to move first, take initiative, light up the room. More action than deliberation.

earth.title: Earth
earth.body: Stable, grounded, material energy. Builds what's tangible and lasting — finances, structure, routine, the body. More foundation than leap.

air.title: Air
air.body: Mental, social, idea-driven energy. Moves through thought, conversation, concepts. More reflection and connection than deep feeling.

water.title: Water
water.body: Emotional, intuitive, deep energy. Lives in feeling and sensing. More felt-sense than hard logic.

cardinal.title: Cardinal
cardinal.body: The starter. Kickoff energy — begins seasons, ideas, movements. Strong as an initiator; the follow-through is the work.

fixed.title: Fixed
fixed.body: The keeper. Steady energy — preserves, deepens, completes. Strong in consistency; can resist when big change is needed.

mutable.title: Mutable
mutable.body: The adapter. Flexible energy — bridges, adjusts, transitions. Versatile; can look inconsistent in a short window.
